content.title: Flip-Cell Wordmark | Pixel Assembly, Extrusion, Recoil, Card Closure
content.summary: Establish one fixed cell matrix, one exact short word and a neutral unflipped baseline. Propagate local cell activation until the complete flat word is readable without misspelling. Grow registered letter depth, layers and one accent while preserving every character position. Use bounded extrusion and recoil so modules return to a stable aligned state. Compress the resolved dimensional word into one clean card and hold the exact lockup.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one fixed cell matrix, one exact short word and a neutral unflipped baseline. + Propagate local cell activation until the complete flat word is readable without misspelling. + Grow registered letter depth, layers and one accent while preserving every character position. + Use bounded extrusion and recoil so modules return to a stable aligned state. + Compress the resolved dimensional word into one clean card and hold the exact lockup.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show an original wall of small square ceramic tiles, all matte ivory and aligned on a fixed orthographic grid; declare the exact word 'MAKER' but show no letters yet. Keep every tile registered as the letter tiles extrude into shallow ceramic relief; add one small amber square above the letter A and no other accents. Pull back as the complete relief word becomes a small ivory workshop card on a rust background; hold exact 'MAKER' with the one amber square and no extra text.
